content.short: BALANCE - a Blockchain Intelligence app dedicated to supporting the Cardano Blockchain Ecosystem

We aim to acheive this mission by creating impactful data visualizations developed through strong collabotration with community members dedicated to imporving decentralization within the Cardano blockchian ecosystem.
